bagPolicy.summary: Jiffy Lube Live allows clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutch bags up to 6" x 9". All bags are subject to search upon entry.
allowed: clear plastic bags (max size 12" x 6" x 12")
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: General admission parking is included with your ticket. For easier entry and exit, consider upgrading to Premier or VIP Parking. Early Parking is also available for those who want to arrive before the rush.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Jiffy Lube Live's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Jiffy Lube Live offers a variety of food and drink options, including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, and Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizzas. Unique offerings include Koko's Bavarian sausages and ColdRush's shaved ice with bold flavors. Concessions also feature classic concert bites like popcorn and nachos, alongside a selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages.
stands: CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Jiffy Lube Live, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Jiffy Lube Live's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Jiffy Lube Live. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Jiffy Lube Live. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
